H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H3320: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H7854: an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H7751: properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H347: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H8535: complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H2388: to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer
H5496: properly, to prick, i.e. (figuratively) stimulate; by implication, to seduce
H1104: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
H2600: gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage
H5785: skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather
H1157: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H5060: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H6936: the crown of the head (as the part most bowed)
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H6901: to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively)
H2398: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H464: Eliphaz, the name of one of Job's friends, and of a son of Esau
H8489: a Temanite or descendant of Teman
H7747: a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach
H5284: a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah
H3259: to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage)
H5110: to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt
H5162: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H7350: remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)
H5234: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning)
H7167: to rend, literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them)
H4598: a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment)
H6083: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H7651: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
